jobdesk-narrow-1.alt: Job Desk in a narrow window: the header and counts stack, the filters wrap onto two lines, and below them sit the green Small teams tile and an applied lead card.
jobdesk-narrow-1.caption: The same desk in a narrow window: the layout stacks for a phone.

jobdesk-leads-1.alt: The Leads tab: a green Small teams tile, a status filter, and lead rows with a fit score, team size, a why line, a gaps line, a main platform button and an "Also on" list.
jobdesk-leads-1.caption: One row per job, with the main platform button and every other place it is listed.

jobdesk-lead-1.alt: One lead up close: fit out of 10 with scores for skills, level and practicality, a line on why it fits, a line on the risk, a confidence label, the team size with its source, and buttons to mark it not interested or expired.
jobdesk-lead-1.caption: Each score says why the role fits, names the real risk, and shows where the facts came from.

jobdesk-pack-1.alt: The Packs tab in two panes: a list of packs on the left with a closed group at the bottom, and an open pack on the right with flags, apply buttons and form questions with drafted answers and character limits.
jobdesk-pack-1.caption: A pack: the real form's questions with drafted answers, and flags for what the agent could not check.

jobdesk-tracker-1.alt: The Tracker tab: a strip of counts, a box for an unfinished application, then applications with the company, role, the employer's hiring system with a line saying which board was used, the inbox, dates, a status menu and the next action.
jobdesk-tracker-1.caption: The tracker keeps where I applied apart from the employer's hiring system (sample data).

jobdesk-insights-1.alt: The Insights tab: a table of platforms with applications sent, replies, next stages and typical reply time.
jobdesk-insights-1.caption: Insights: sent, replied, next stage and typical reply time, for each platform (sample data).

jobdesk-mark-before-1.alt: The Leads tab filtered to Applied: two applied jobs, Quillstone Pay and Kestrelway Travel, each with options to mark it not interested or expired. The header shows 4 packs ready.
jobdesk-mark-before-1.caption: Before: two applied jobs

jobdesk-mark-after-1.alt: The same view after Kestrelway Travel was marked Expired: only Quillstone Pay is left, and the header and the Packs tab now show 3 packs.
jobdesk-mark-after-1.caption: After: Kestrelway Travel marked Expired

jobdesk-agents-1.alt: The Agents tab: four agent cards, each with what it does, a note that it runs only when Run now is pressed, a Run now button, and the start of its last run summary.
jobdesk-agents-1.caption: Run now for each agent, and a note on what its last run did and assumed.
